rules.control_character: Unicode Cc character other than tab, CR or LF.
rules.invisible_format_character: Unicode Cf character other than joiners U+200C/U+200D.
rules.possible_mojibake: Common broken UTF-8 sequences; heuristic only.
rules.html_entity: Named or numeric entity that html.unescape changes.
rules.url_or_mention_only: Only URLs/mentions, whitespace and surrounding punctuation.
rules.short_text: Fewer than 3 whitespace-separated units OR fewer than 10 characters.
rules.no_letters_or_numbers: No Unicode letters or numbers; may be valid emoji sentiment.
rules.repeated_character_run: Same non-whitespace character repeated at least 6 times.
rules.possible_promotion: At least 2 distinct promotion phrases; heuristic only.

suspicious_text.policy: Flag only; no additional removal or text modification. Flags are not confirmed errors.

checks: row reconciliation, unique IDs/text, no prepared exact audit overlap, valid labels, originals unchanged: PASS

rules.random_split: none; expert development set will be used
rules.fuzzy_screen: NFKC/casefold/whitespace equivalence plus adjacent sorted pairs with common first 12 characters, minimum 30 chars and SequenceMatcher >=0.95; not exhaustive
rules.near_duplicate_policy: User-selected exclusion of every candidate endpoint in original flagged pairs, regardless of label; preserve reserved records; no iterative rescreening
rules.suspicious_text_policy: Flag only; preserve text and do not automatically exclude suspicious rows
